prompt_text:
You are reviewing a business situation with updated facts.
Use the latest updates when making the final recommendation.
Do not rely on superseded facts.

Scenario ID: gtm_constraints_001
Domain: gtm_constraints
Topic: eu-market-entry-budget-freeze

Initial facts:
- The team planned to launch a Germany outbound campaign in Q3.
- The paid acquisition budget for Germany was approved at $180000.
- The plan depended on field events and SDR hiring in Germany.

Updated facts:
- The Germany expansion budget is now frozen at $0 for the next two quarters.
- The team must avoid net-new SDR hiring and field events in Germany until the freeze lifts.

Distractors:
- Brand awareness in Germany is still rising quarter over quarter.
- A reseller prospect asked for a follow-up deck.

Task: recommend the next business decision.
Return exactly these sections:
## Latest Facts
- List the newest facts you are using.
## Decision
- Give one clear recommendation.
## Rationale
- Explain why the latest facts change the decision.
## Stale Facts To Avoid
- Name any earlier assumptions that should no longer drive the decision.
raw_response:
Latest Facts

• The Germany expansion budget is now frozen at $0 for the next two quarters.
• The team must avoid net-new SDR hiring and field events in Germany until the freeze lifts.

Decision

• Do not proceed with the planned Germany outbound launch in Q3; switch to a no-budget Germany holding plan focused on lightweight partner/inbound follow-up only until the freeze lifts.

Rationale

• The original launch depended on paid acquisition, field events, and SDR hiring.
• The newest facts remove all three enabling conditions:
• budget is now $0
• net-new SDR hiring is not allowed
• field events are not allowed
• That means the original Germany launch plan is no longer executable.
• A constrained holding pattern is the correct next decision because it preserves optionality without violating the current operating constraints.

Stale Facts To Avoid

• The paid acquisition budget for Germany was approved at $180000.
• The plan depended on field events and SDR hiring in Germany.
• The earlier assumption that a full Germany outbound campaign could launch in Q3 under the original resource plan.__END__
